question: Who is the Houston Rockets' general manager in the data?
sql:
SELECT team_id, city, team_nickname, general_manager
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed"
WHERE LOWER(city) LIKE '%houston%' AND LOWER(team_nickname) LIKE '%rockets%'

question: Who were the Toronto Raptors' five starters on June 13, 2019?
When was Karl-Anthony Towns born, according to the data?
sql:
WITH players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PLAYER_ID AS player_id, PLAYER_NAME AS player_name
  FROM "nba_analysis"."RAW"."raw_players"
  WHERE LOWER(PLAYER_NAME) = 'karl-anthony towns'
),
births AS (
  SELECT LOWER(player_name) AS name_key, MAX(BIRTH_DATE) AS birth_date
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."src_player_information"
  WHERE LOWER(player_name) = 'karl-anthony towns'
  GROUP BY LOWER(player_name)
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, b.birth_date
FROM players p
JOIN births b ON LOWER(p.player_name) = b.name_key
ORDER BY p.player_id

question: How many players averaged at least 25 points per game in the 2019-20 regular season, among those who played at least 40 games?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_count
FROM (
  SELECT player_id
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts"
  WHERE season = 2019
    AND CAST(game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '2%'
    AND participated = true
  GROUP BY player_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 40 AND AVG(points) >= 25
) t

question: Which month of the 2018-19 regular season had the most games?

question: What was the biggest margin of victory in any game in the data? Give the winner, the loser, the date and the margin.
sql:
SELECT
  g.game_id,
  g.game_date,
  g.team_id AS winner_team_id,
  w.city || ' ' || w.team_nickname AS winner,
  g.opponent_team_id AS loser_team_id,
  l.city || ' ' || l.team_nickname AS loser,
  g.team_points AS winner_points,
  g.opponent_points AS loser_points,
  g.team_points - g.opponent_points AS margin
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_team_game_facts" g
LEFT JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" w ON g.team_id = w.team_id
LEFT JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" l ON g.opponent_team_id = l.team_id
WHERE g.team_won = true
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 1

question: How many games did Andre Iguodala start in the 2015-16 regular season?

FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.details_game_id
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."src_games_details" d

question: How many back-to-backs did the Denver Nuggets play in the 2017-18 regular season?
Which teams were swept in the 2017 playoffs?
sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT games_game_id, home_team_id, visitor_team_id, home_team_wins
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."src_games"
  WHERE CAST(games_game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '4%'
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM game_date_est) = 2017
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    games_game_id,
    LEAST(home_team_id, visitor_team_id) AS team_a,
    GREATEST(home_team_id, visitor_team_id) AS team_b,
    CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN home_team_id ELSE visitor_team_id END AS winner_id,
    CASE WHEN home_team_wins = 1 THEN visitor_team_id ELSE home_team_id END AS loser_id
  FROM g
),
w AS (
  SELECT team_a, team_b, winner_id, loser_id, COUNT(*) AS series_wins
  FROM r
  GROUP BY team_a, team_b, winner_id, loser_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT team_a, team_b, SUM(series_wins) AS series_games
  FROM w
  GROUP BY team_a, team_b
)
SELECT
  w.loser_id AS swept_team_id,
  l.city AS swept_team_city,
  l.team_nickname AS swept_team_nickname,
  w.winner_id AS sweeping_team_id,
  wt.city AS sweeping_team_city,
  wt.team_nickname AS sweeping_team_nickname,
  w.series_wins AS games_in_series
FROM w
JOIN s ON w.team_a = s.team_a AND w.team_b = s.team_b AND w.series_wins = s.series_games
LEFT JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" l ON l.team_id = w.loser_id
LEFT JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" wt ON wt.team_id = w.winner_id
WHERE w.series_wins >= 4
ORDER BY l.city, l.team_nickname

question: What was the longest winning streak in the 2012-13 regular season, and which team had it?
sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT games_game_id, game_date_est, home_team_id, visitor_team_id, home_team_wins
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."src_games"
  WHERE season = 2012
    AND CAST(games_game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '2%'
    AND home_team_wins IS NOT NULL
),
t AS (
  SELECT games_game_id, game_date_est, home_team_id AS team_id, home_team_wins AS won FROM g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT games_game_id, game_date_est, visitor_team_id AS team_id, 1 - home_team_wins AS won FROM g
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    team_id,
    won,
    game_date_est,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY game_date_est, games_game_id)
      - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, won ORDER BY game_date_est, games_game_id) AS grp
  FROM t
),
s AS (
  SELECT
    team_id,
    grp,
    COUNT(*) AS winning_streak,
    MIN(game_date_est) AS streak_start,
    MAX(game_date_est) AS streak_end
  FROM r
  WHERE won = 1
  GROUP BY team_id, grp
)
SELECT team_id, winning_streak, streak_start, streak_end
FROM s
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY winning_streak DESC) = 1
ORDER BY team_id

question: Which teams made the 2021 playoffs through the play-in?
sql:
SELECT t.team_id, d.team_abbreviation, d.team_nickname
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_id
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts"
  WHERE CAST(game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%'
    AND season = 2020
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM game_date) = 2021
) t
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_id
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts"
  WHERE CAST(game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '4%'
    AND season = 2020
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM game_date) = 2021
) p ON p.team_id = t.team_id
LEFT JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" d ON CAST(d.team_id AS BIGINT) = t.team_id
ORDER BY t.team_id

question: What was the 2018-19 regular-season record of the team that lists Masai Ujiri as its general manager?
sql:
WITH tg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.team_id,
    p.game_id,
    CASE WHEN (p.is_home AND p.home_team_wins = 1) OR (NOT p.is_home AND p.home_team_wins = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts" p
  WHERE p.season = 2018
    AND CAST(p.game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '2%'
)
SELECT
  t.team_id,
  t.team_nickname,
  SUM(tg.win) AS wins,
  COUNT(*) - SUM(tg.win) AS losses
FROM tg
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" t
  ON tg.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE LOWER(t.general_manager) LIKE '%masai ujiri%'
GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_nickname

question: Who scored the most points against the San Antonio Spurs in the 2013-14 regular season, and how many?
For which team has Paul George scored the most points in the data, and how many?
sql:
SELECT t.team_id, d.team_nickname, d.team_abbreviation, SUM(t.points) AS total_points
FROM (
  SELECT team_id, points
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts"
  WHERE LOWER(player_name) = 'paul george'
    AND participated = true
) t
LEFT JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" d
  ON t.team_id = d.team_id
GROUP BY t.team_id, d.team_nickname, d.team_abbreviation
ORDER BY total_points DESC

question: How many games did Eastern Conference teams win against Western Conference teams in the 2016-17 regular season?
What is the most points a player has scored in a single game at Madison Square Garden in the data, and who scored them?
sql:
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, p.points, p.game_id, p.game_date
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts" p
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" t
  ON t.team_id = CASE WHEN p.is_home THEN p.team_id ELSE p.opponent_team_id END
WHERE t.arena ILIKE '%Madison Square Garden%'
  AND p.participated = true
  AND p.points IS NOT NULL
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.points DESC) = 1
ORDER BY p.game_date

question: How many games did the New Orleans Hornets win in the 2007-08 regular season?
sql:
SELECT t.team_id, SUM(CASE WHEN g.team_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_team_game_facts" g
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" t ON g.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE t.city ILIKE '%New Orleans%'
  AND (t.team_nickname ILIKE '%Hornets%' OR t.team_nickname ILIKE '%Pelicans%')
  AND g.season = 2007
  AND CAST(g.game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '2%'
GROUP BY t.team_id
